title.vi: Lệnh Hợp tác xã (Sửa đổi Điều 59(6)) 2021
title.th: คำสั่งสหกรณ์ (การแก้ไขมาตรา 59(6)) 2021

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Co‑operative Societies (Modification of Section 59(6)) Order 2021 and comes into operation on 19 May 2021.

2. Section 59(6) of the Act is, in its application to the Singapore National Co‑operative Federation Limited, modified to the extent that —
(a)all or any of the duties of the secretary or treasurer, or both, may be delegated under section 59(6)(a) of the Act to an individual who is appointed as a chief executive officer of the Singapore National Co‑operative Federation Limited, whether or not that individual’s appointment is on a full time basis; and
(b)where all the duties of the secretary or treasurer, or both, are delegated to a chief executive officer, whether or not appointed on a full time basis, the Singapore National Co‑operative Federation Limited may under section 59(6)(b) of the Act operate without electing a secretary or a treasurer, or both.
